subdivision_of_building: Street Level, ground floor & lower  external garden level (within School’s boundaries), both at the front entrance area of School only.

application_details.scheme_name: Sarum School: Creation of an Additional Pedestrian Exit from the School to Eton Avenue  Boundary Dwarf Wall, wheelchair platform lift

phasing_details.phase_detail: single phase: all works to be addressed together.

description:
NOTE: the application does NOT include any change of use
a.	Proposed Alterations to Existing dwarf Boundary Wall, Reasons for intervention, intent: 
 introduction of  a secondary ‘exit gate’ that would be used at the end of day school time and for the exit of children only.

b. Proposed  Intent: to improve accessibility issues with the introduction of an external wheelchair accessible platform lift (within School’s boundaries).

c. Proposed introduction of a Flag Pole, with Flag (within School’s boundaries),
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

SP_170_01, SP_170_02, EX_GA_171_01, EX_GA_171_02, EX_GA_171_03, EX_GA_171_04, PP_GA_171_01, PP_GA_171_02, PP_GA_171_03, PP_GA_171_04, PP_GA_170_20, PP_GA_170_21, PP_GA_170_22,  EX_PH_170_30, EX_PH_170_31, Design and Access Statement and proposed alterations, Sarum School_BNG- Reg 4 Exemption Report, Sarum School- BNG Evidence Statement, Sarum School- Exemption further notes, Sarum School - Particulate Matter, Sarum School - Water Management.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 4 - Before the relevant part of the work is begun, the following, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority: 

a) Plan, elevation and section drawings, including image of the flag pole and flag at scale of 1:10/1:50/1:100 to be submitted.  

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
